name: google-workspace-mcp-principal-scoped-google-4e23
instr:
Allow a verified gateway principal to own and use one or more separately named Google accounts without weakening credential isolation. Consent, session association, request selection, service construction, status reporting, and durable storage must agree on the same canonical ownership. Callers that do not select an account retain existing single-account behavior.

Binding is immutable, idempotent for its owner, and exclusive across principals; local-directory and GCS storage preserve that law while retaining their existing concurrency failure behavior. `auth.account_binding` exports `AccountBinding`, `AccountBindingSnapshot`, `BindingIntent`, `BindingCallbackResult`, `AccountBindingConflict`, and `AccountBindingManager`; the manager supports `__init__(self, store)`, `bind(self, principal_email, account_email)`, and `snapshot(self, principal_email, selected_account_email=None)`. `auth.account_binding_store` exports `AccountBindingStore`, whose `get_by_account`, `list_for_principal`, and `create` operations provide durable ownership, while `bind(self, principal_email, account_email)` applies it. `auth.account_selection` exports `AccountNotBoundError`, `AccountSelection`, and `resolve_account_selection`; explicit choices must be owned, while omission resolves only an unambiguous compatible account. Consent intent is single-use, session-bound, tamper-resistant, and permits the verified principal and consented Google account to differ. Credentials and session association occur on
